_comment: Flora's first quest, the opening. Benjamin teaches Harvest on the talk; a Beet takes damage only from a `harvest`-tagged aura, so the talk orders the field by content. Objectives in one stage are unordered. Reward on Flora's turn-in, the L9 half-level rule at L1. Count and reward [PLACEHOLDER].
title: Ready for Harvest

stages.journal: Harvest 10 beets on the field east of farmer Flora's house.
The beets are harvested. Flora is waiting.
